slides.title: The document is good
slides.body:
Honest timeline.
Named contributing factors.
A list at the bottom.

slides.title: Six months later
slides.body:
*One* got done.
Somebody was annoyed
enough that week.

slides.title: Not laziness
slides.body:
The list was written at the one
moment nobody could
*say no* to it.

slides.title: Why agreement was free
slides.body:
No date.
No owner.
No budget. *Yet*.

slides.title: Two weeks later
slides.body:
The regret faded.
The work still has none of those.
Now it *loses* to the roadmap.

slides.title: The blunt test
slides.body:
No name, no date,
no place in a real workload
= *not an action*.

slides.title:
A *feeling* somebody had
on a bad day.
